```{python}
def calc_accruals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .sort("gvkey", "datadate")
        .with_columns(
            lag_at=pl.col("at").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
            d_ca=pl.col("act").diff().over("gvkey"),
            d_cash=pl.col("che").diff().over("gvkey"),
            d_cl=pl.col("lct").diff().over("gvkey"),
            d_std=pl.col("dlc").diff().over("gvkey"),
            d_rev=pl.col("sale").diff().over("gvkey"),
            d_rec=pl.col("rect").diff().over("gvkey"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            acc_raw=(
                pl.col("d_ca") - pl.col("d_cash")
                - pl.col("d_cl") + pl.col("d_std")
                - pl.col("dp")
            )
        )
    )
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def predict_ols(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    *,
    y_col: str,
    x_cols: list[str],
    add_intercept: bool = False,
) -> pl.Series:
    train = (
        df
        .filter(~pl.col("part"))
        .select(y_col, *x_cols)
        .drop_nulls()
    )

    if train.height == 0:
        return pl.Series([None] * df.height, dtype=pl.Float64)

    full = df.select(*x_cols)
    valid = full.select(pl.all_horizontal(pl.all().is_not_null())).to_series()
    out = np.full(df.height, np.nan)

    X = train.select(x_cols).to_numpy()
    y = train[y_col].to_numpy()
    X_pred = full.filter(valid).to_numpy()

    if add_intercept:
        X = np.column_stack([np.ones(train.height), X])
        X_pred = np.column_stack([np.ones(X_pred.shape[0]), X_pred])

    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    out[valid.to_numpy()] = X_pred @ beta
    return pl.Series(out)


def fit_jones(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "acc_at")
        .with_columns(
            nda_jones=predict_ols(
                df,
                y_col="acc_at",
                x_cols=["one_at", "d_rev_at", "ppe_at"],
            )
        )
        .with_columns(da_jones=pl.col("acc_at") - pl.col("nda_jones"))
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "nda_jones", "da_jones")
    )


def fit_mod_jones(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "acc_at")
        .with_columns(
            nda_mod_jones=predict_ols(
                df,
                y_col="acc_at",
                x_cols=["one_at", "d_rev_alt_at", "ppe_at"],
            )
        )
        .with_columns(
            da_mod_jones=pl.col("acc_at") - pl.col("nda_mod_jones")
        )
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "nda_mod_jones", "da_mod_jones")
    )


def fit_industry(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "acc_at")
        .with_columns(
            nda_industry=predict_ols(
                df,
                y_col="acc_at",
                x_cols=["acc_ind"],
                add_intercept=True,
            )
        )
        .with_columns(da_industry=pl.col("acc_at") -
                                  pl.col("nda_industry"))
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "nda_industry", "da_industry")
    )


def get_nda(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df_mod = (
        calc_accruals(df)
        .with_columns(
            sic2=(
                pl.col("sic")
                .cast(pl.Int32, strict=False)
                .cast(pl.Utf8)
                .str.slice(0, 2)
            ),
            acc_at=pl.col("acc_raw") / pl.col("lag_at"),
            one_at=1 / pl.col("lag_at"),
            d_rev_at=pl.col("d_rev") / pl.col("lag_at"),
            d_rev_alt_at=(
                pl.col("d_rev") - pl.col("d_rec")
            ) / pl.col("lag_at"),
            ppe_at=pl.col("ppegt") / pl.col("lag_at"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            acc_ind=(
                pl.when(~pl.col("part"))
                .then(pl.col("acc_at"))
                .otherwise(None)
                .median()
                .over("sic2")
            )
        )
    )

    da_healy = (
        df_mod
        .sort(["gvkey", "fyear"])
        .with_columns(
            nda_healy=(
                pl.when(~pl.col("part"))
                .then(pl.col("acc_at"))
                .otherwise(None)
                .mean()
                .over("gvkey")
            ),
            nda_deangelo=pl.col("acc_at").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            da_healy=pl.col("acc_at") - pl.col("nda_healy"),
            da_deangelo=pl.col("acc_at") - pl.col("nda_deangelo"),
        )
        .select(
            "gvkey", "fyear", "part", "nda_healy",
            "da_healy", "nda_deangelo", "da_deangelo"
        )
    )

    by_firm = df_mod.partition_by("gvkey", as_dict=False)
    jones_rows = []
    mod_jones_rows = []
    industry_rows = []
    for subdf in by_firm:
        jones_rows.append(fit_jones(subdf))
        mod_jones_rows.append(fit_mod_jones(subdf))
        industry_rows.append(fit_industry(subdf))

    df_jones = pl.concat(jones_rows, how="vertical")
    df_mod_jones = pl.concat(mod_jones_rows, how="vertical")
    df_industry = pl.concat(industry_rows, how="vertical")

    return (
        da_healy
        .join(df_jones, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="left")
        .join(df_mod_jones, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="left")
        .join(df_industry, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="left")
    )
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
```
```{python}
def fit_model(subdf: pl.DataFrame, measure: str = "healy") -> pl.DataFrame:
    fit_data = (
        subdf
        .select("gvkey", f"da_{measure}", "part")
        .with_columns(part_i=pl.col("part").cast(pl.Int8))
        .drop_nulls([f"da_{measure}", "part_i"])
    )
    if fit_data.height <= 2:
        return pl.DataFrame()

    y = fit_data[f"da_{measure}"].to_numpy()
    part_i = fit_data["part_i"].to_numpy()
    y0 = y[part_i == 0]
    y1 = y[part_i == 1]
    n0 = len(y0)
    n1 = len(y1)

    if n0 == 0 or n1 == 0:
        return pl.DataFrame()

    mean0 = y0.mean()
    mean1 = y1.mean()
    estimate = mean1 - mean0
    df_resid = n0 + n1 - 2
    resid_ss = ((y0 - mean0) ** 2).sum() + ((y1 - mean1) ** 2).sum()
    std_error = np.sqrt((resid_ss / df_resid) * ((1 / n0) + (1 / n1)))
    statistic = estimate / std_error
    pvalue = 2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(statistic), df=df_resid)

    return pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "gvkey": pl.Series([int(subdf["gvkey"][0])], dtype=pl.Int32),
            "measure": [measure],
            "estimate": [float(estimate)],
            "std_error": [float(std_error)],
            "statistic": [float(statistic)],
            "pvalue": [float(pvalue)],
            "df_resid": [float(df_resid)],
        }
    )


def multi_fit(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return pl.concat(
        [
            fit_model(subdf, measure)
            for subdf in df.partition_by("gvkey", as_dict=False)
            for measure in ["healy", "deangelo", "jones", "mod_jones",
                            "industry"]
        ],
        how="diagonal",
    )
```

```{python}
def h_test(t_stat: float | None, df_resid: float | None) -> dict[str, bool | None]:
    if t_stat is None or df_resid is None:
        return {
            "neg_p01": None, "neg_p05": None,
            "pos_p01": None, "pos_p05": None
        }
    return {
        "neg_p01": bool(stats.t.cdf(t_stat, df=df_resid) < 0.01),
        "neg_p05": bool(stats.t.cdf(t_stat, df=df_resid) < 0.05),
        "pos_p01": bool(stats.t.sf(t_stat, df=df_resid) < 0.01),
        "pos_p05": bool(stats.t.sf(t_stat, df=df_resid) < 0.05),
    }

test_results = results.hstack(
    pl.DataFrame(
        [
            h_test(row["statistic"], row["df_resid"])
            for row in results.iter_rows(named=True)
        ]
    )
)

num_cols = ["neg_p01", "neg_p05", "pos_p01", "pos_p05"]

def binom_test(x: pl.Series, p: float) -> float:
    values = x.drop_nulls()
    if len(values) == 0:
        return float("nan")
    n_success = int(values.cast(pl.Int8).sum())
    return float(stats.binomtest(k=n_success, n=len(values), p=p).pvalue)
```

```{python}
def h_test_5(t_stat: float | None, df_resid: float | None) -> bool | None:
    if t_stat is None or df_resid is None:
        return None
    return bool(stats.t.sf(t_stat, df=df_resid) < 0.05)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def manipulate(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    level: float = 0.0,
    type: str = "expense",
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df_mod = (
        df
        .sort(["gvkey", "datadate"])
        .with_columns(
            ni_ratio=(
                pl.when(~pl.col("part"))
                .then(pl.col("ni") / pl.col("sale"))
                .otherwise(None)
                .median()
                .over("gvkey")
            ),
            lag_at=pl.col("at").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            manip_amt=pl.col("lag_at") * level,
        )
        .with_columns(
            manip_amt_gross=pl.col("manip_amt") / pl.col("ni_ratio"),
            part_lag=(
                pl.col("part").shift(1).over("gvkey").fill_null(False)
            ),
        )
    )

    if type == "expense":
        return df_mod.with_columns(
            lct=(
                pl.when(pl.col("part"))
                .then(pl.col("lct") - pl.col("manip_amt"))
                .otherwise(pl.col("lct"))
            )
        ).drop("part_lag")

    if type == "revenue":
        return (
            df_mod
            .with_columns(
                sale=(
                    pl.when(pl.col("part"))
                    .then(pl.col("sale") + pl.col("manip_amt"))
                    .when(pl.col("part_lag"))
                    .then(pl.col("sale") - pl.col("manip_amt"))
                    .otherwise(pl.col("sale"))
                ),
                rect=(
                    pl.when(pl.col("part"))
                    .then(pl.col("rect") + pl.col("manip_amt"))
                    .otherwise(pl.col("rect"))
                ),
                act=(
                    pl.when(pl.col("part"))
                    .then(pl.col("act") + pl.col("manip_amt"))
                    .otherwise(pl.col("act"))
                ),
            )
            .drop("part_lag")
        )

    if type == "margin":
        cond = pl.col("part") & (pl.col("ni_ratio") > 0)
        cond_lag = pl.col("part_lag") & (pl.col("ni_ratio") > 0)
        return (
            df_mod
            .with_columns(
                sale=(
                    pl.when(cond)
                    .then(pl.col("sale") + pl.col("manip_amt_gross"))
                    .when(cond_lag)
                    .then(pl.col("sale") - pl.col("manip_amt_gross"))
                    .otherwise(pl.col("sale"))
                ),
                rect=(
                    pl.when(cond)
                    .then(pl.col("rect") + pl.col("manip_amt_gross"))
                    .otherwise(pl.col("rect"))
                ),
                act=(
                    pl.when(cond)
                    .then(pl.col("act") + pl.col("manip_amt_gross"))
                    .otherwise(pl.col("act"))
                ),
                lct=(
                    pl.when(cond)
                    .then(
                        pl.col("lct") + pl.col("manip_amt_gross")
                        - pl.col("manip_amt")
                    )
                    .otherwise(pl.col("lct"))
                ),
            )
            .drop("part_lag")
        )

    return df_mod.drop("part_lag")
```

```{python}
# Long-running: iterates over a grid of 33 (level, type) combinations,
# calling get_nda() and multi_fit() for each — takes several minutes.
grid = [
    (level, manip_type)
    for level in np.arange(0, 1.01, 0.1)
    for manip_type in ["expense", "revenue", "margin"]
]

with ptime():
    power_rows = []
    for level, manip_type in grid:
        results_df = multi_fit(
            get_nda(
                manipulate(
                    merged_sample_1,
                    level=level,
                    type=manip_type,
                )
            )
        )
        summary_df = (
            results_df
            .with_columns(
                rej_null=pl.Series(
                    "rej_null",
                    [
                        h_test_5(row["statistic"], row["df_resid"])
                        for row in results_df.iter_rows(named=True)
                    ],
                    dtype=pl.Boolean,
                )
            )
            .group_by("measure")
            .agg(
                prop_reject=pl.col("rej_null")
                .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
                .mean()
            )
            .with_columns(
                level=pl.lit(float(level)),
                manip_type=pl.lit(manip_type),
            )
            .select("level", "manip_type", "measure", "prop_reject")
        )
        power_rows.append(summary_df)

power_plot_data = pl.concat(power_rows, how="vertical")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# Depends on power_plot_data above (eval: false).
(
    power_plot_data
    .ggplot(aes(x="level", y="prop_reject"))
    .geom_line()
    .facet_grid("measure ~ manip_type")
)
```
